input.summary:
Flat 2E front room furnished in parts/room-13.mjs: oriel window bench of dark_oak_stairs, a table with three chairs, an armchair, a dresser with a flower pot, and two fence-post lamps, all drawn with layers() on the plan grid.
Lit by five standing lanterns (table, dresser, two posts, one more on a post): light min 10, no dark or dim cells; `mcd room` says OK. Inside view reads as a sitting room.
make.sh ran clean (18 placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE); the saved build.nbt is whole.

waste.what: Hung lanterns from y 22 assuming a ceiling at y 23; the check found nothing above (the loft floor isn't built over this room), so I rebuilt with standing lanterns on blocks.
waste.cost: one full make.sh rebuild and a second design pass (about 2 minutes)
waste.tool: `mcd room` should report 'lantern hanging with no block above' (it only flagged the problem in `mcd check`), so the room check could catch it before the rebuild.

waste.what: Worked out each cell's light level by hand to choose lantern spots (dim corners at z 17-18), then added lanterns one at a time and re-ran make.sh.
waste.tool: `mcd room --suggest n` or a dry-run that lists the lantern spots for a given count would save the iterations.

waste.what: Worked out stair facing by hand (a chair facing south has facing north) and checked each seat's direction in my head.
waste.tool: A `mcd states`-style helper in layers, e.g. a legend key like seat:south that sets facing from the facing direction you sit toward, would remove this.

companions.task: Check the chairs and bench: which way each seat faces, and that its back sits against the wall or the table's far side, so the seats read as chairs.
Lay a wool rug under the table and chairs. The palette has no carpet, so I left the floor bare.

left: No ceiling at y 23 above this room, so no hanging lanterns; all light is standing lanterns on the table, dresser and two fence posts.
The room check's walk list names 5 cells as 'unreached' (13,21,17, 16,22,16, 19,21,17, 20,21,13, 20,21,14); these are furniture and post tops, the verdict is OK, and the grid shows them as 'o'.
No rug: the palette has no wool carpet, so the 'wool carpets for rugs' from the trade notes was not used.
plan.md and elements.md have no checkbox for this room, so nothing was ticked. The 'Light: all rooms >= 8' item in elements.md is still open for the lamplighter's pass over the whole building.
